overview.text: “备” means “prepare,” “be ready or complete,” and “equipment.” Its visible split is 夂 above 田, but these modern parts do not establish how the character was historically formed.

components.text: 夂 is the visible upper part of modern 备; its historical role here is unresolved.
田 is the visible lower part of modern 备; its historical role here is unresolved.
In one analysis of traditional 備, 人 depicts a person carrying a container; it is absent from current 备.
The received analysis assigns 𤰈 a sound role in 備, though its historical sound basis is unverified.
